interpretation.finding: Half of the 36 distinct Japan-38 species binomials are already present in the original exhaustive Azami public-image source stream. Three additional binomials are lost only by strict spatial filtering and can be recovered for non-spatial trait summaries without any new biological sampling.
interpretation.true_current_image_source_gap: The other 18 binomials are absent from the current Azami exhaustive source pool rather than merely lost by detector or coordinate filtering.
interpretation.next_action_before_field_sampling: Run a targeted synonym-aware public-image/herbarium recovery for the 18 source-pool gaps, prioritizing taxa that are direct nuclear tips and that increase representation of internal branches of the dominant Japanese radiation.

claim_boundary: Source-pool presence is not taxonomic validation, adequate replication, independent-population coverage, evolutionary rate or adaptation. Broad binomial image records cannot be silently assigned to infraspecific Japan-38 paper concepts.
